# Decision - Keep replacement charges for lost items

## Context

Ending [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]] raised the question of whether to drop all charges. Lost and damaged items cost the network about 31,000 dollars a year to replace.

## Decision

Keep charging the replacement cost for items that are lost or damaged. An item still out 45 days after its due date is billed as lost. If the patron returns it in usable condition, the bill is cancelled.

## Why

Without a replacement charge, popular titles disappear from the collection and waiting lists grow. The Pinecrest pilot kept replacement charges too, so the [[Pilot results - Pinecrest no-charge summer]] already reflect this rule.
